cohort_total_n_excerpt: The study population consisted of 997 middle-aged Finnish men (56.1 ± 6.6 yr) in the Kuopio Ischaemic Heart Disease Risk Factor (KIHD) cohort.
reason: The prospective cohort evaluated incident prostate cancer overall. The abstract does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: After adjusting for age, examination yr, family history of cancer, BMI, pack-yr of smoking, alcohol consumption, education, physical activity, serum total cholesterol, and serum α-linolenic acid, men in the highest tertile of serum concentrations of β-carotene had 2.3-fold higher risk of prostate cancer as compared to those in the lowest tertile (RR = 2.29, 95% CI: 1.12-4.66; P = 0.023).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate concerns incident prostate cancer overall, without an aggressive-disease restriction.
